snippet.title: Beavis and Butthead: Virtual Stupidity (1995) PC Complete Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A beginning to end playthrough of Viacom New Media's 1995 PC game, Beavis and Butthead: Virtual Stupidity.

The game is absolutely phenomenal. That's all I've really got to say about it.

You can see the PlayStation version here: https://youtu.be/q3eoVfr3Mmc

No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
